## Noon assessment for Friday October 30

**Own conditional analysis:** Thursday's intraday split is technology weakness versus small-cap relative strength. That is dispersion, not a uniform risk-off call. Treat yesterday's support as potential resistance after a break, and require Friday's post-ECI opening range to confirm before choosing a package. Today's tape is unfinished; these are reference zones, not a prediction of Thursday's close.

### Intraday observations refreshed around noon Pacific

The saved public Yahoo five-minute series below were retrieved after the requested refresh start. Last bar timestamps and retrieval times differ; bars can be partial/delayed. Ranges are through the available snapshot, not final closing extremes. VIX has a 14:44:46 ET last observation, about 15 minutes older than the noon refresh, and its available-day range may include extended index-calculation hours. SPX is a cash index in points; all ETFs are USD/share; VIX is an index, not an ETF option quote.

### Technical map and recent-session context

Completed daily inputs through October 28 remain separate from today's five-minute snapshot. SPX's prior 7,718 low and 7,734–7,736 SMA20/prior-high cluster become reclaim tests; 7,698 SMA50 and October 27's 7,677 low are nearby support references. Above 7,758–7,770 is the stronger recovery threshold. QQQ's prior low 720.30 and prior high 726.12 remain overhead reference levels after the earnings-driven gap; the October 27 low 713.59 is an immediate pivot, while the 20-day average 732.48 and 50-day 725.42 describe the damaged recovery context. IWM's prior high 281.47 and prior close approximately 281.3 are support/reclaim references; 284.64 recent high and approximately 285.00 falling SMA50 are the next acceptance test. Its 200-day average is 278.53. These averages use completed daily closes only, not partial Thursday bars.

[QQQ's latest completed history](https://stockanalysis.com/etf/qqq/history/) shows October 22 selloff volume around 64.6 million versus about 30–33 million on recovery days; that qualifies the rebound's strength, without proving future selling. [IWM's completed history](https://stockanalysis.com/etf/iwm/history/) shows recent closes 275.75 → 276.99 → 280.18 → 281.29. Saved Yahoo's 281.36 October 28 close differs slightly: use rounded 281.3/281.5 zones and refresh Friday rather than invent precision.

**Cross-asset scenarios:** use the noon TLT snapshot against 81.27–81.47 reclaim and 80.73 prior-low references. A Treasury rebound while QQQ falls would favor an earnings/rotation explanation over a simple yields-up thesis; it does not by itself prove causation. GLD weakness would likewise contradict a blanket gold-safe-haven claim. If TLT fails back below the reclaim area and yields rise, QQQ downside can reinforce; if TLT holds and technology reclaims the gap with broader participation, abandon the bearish call-spread thesis. Conflicting confirmations mean no trade. VIX is a broad 30-day SPX measure; no current ETF IV/skew edge is asserted.

## What changed today and what matters next

[BEA's advance Q3 GDP release](https://www.bea.gov/news/2026/gdp-advance-estimate-3rd-quarter-2026) reports **3.4% annualized growth**, versus 2.2% in Q2. [September personal income/outlays](https://www.bea.gov/news/2026/personal-income-and-outlays-september-2026) reports headline PCE **+0.5% month/month, +3.6% year/year**, and core **+0.3% month/month, +3.1% year/year**; real PCE rose less than 0.1% and real disposable income fell 0.3%. These are released facts, not tomorrow's forecasts. Core is not +0.5%.

Microsoft/Alphabet earnings and the technology gap make company-specific dispersion relevant; [Microsoft's issuer release](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/10/28/microsoft-announces-first-quarter-results-2/) and [Reuters' Alphabet coverage](https://new.streetinsider.com/Reuters/Alphabet%2Bshares%2Bfall%2Bafter%2Brevenue%2Bmiss%2C%2Bcash%2Bburn%2Bworsens/27249195.html) are context, not evidence that every index must move together. **Amazon's 17:00 ET Thursday call is still ahead of this noon snapshot**, per its [official announcement](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/company-news/amazon-earnings-q3-2026-report); its result can reset Friday's QQQ levels. Do not imply those results were known at noon.

| SF Fed AI and the Economy: Daly welcome | 12:00 ET (09:00 Pacific) | [Official agenda](https://www.frbsf.org/wp-content/uploads/2026-FRB-SF-AI-Symposium-Conf-Agenda.pdf). A conference appearance, not a promised policy decision; check live remarks before retaining short volatility. |
| Chevron earnings call | 11:00 ET | [Issuer event calendar](https://chevroncorp.gcs-web.com/events-and-presentations/upcoming-events). Recheck sector leadership. |

[NYSE's calendar](https://www.nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars) verifies Friday October 30 is the next regular session, 09:30–16:00 ET. It is the final weekday/session of October; month-end flows can add noise, but no flow direction or magnitude is assumed. Unexpected policy/geopolitical news remains unquantified. Verify additional official appearances before entry.
